name: pua-clean
description: Telemetry-free fork of tanweai/pua. Every outbound network path (heartbeat, session upload, leaderboard, remote prompt fetch, payment) has been deleted from the source, not merely disabled.

plugins.name: pua
plugins.description: Opt-in productivity coaching for Claude Code — telemetry-free fork. All network calls removed (no heartbeat, no session upload, no leaderboard, no remote command fetch, no payment flow). Use for explicit PUA/try-harder requests, user frustration after repeated failures, requests to retry or change approach, passive/low-quality work complaints, completion checks, evidence requests, test/verification reminders, and Ding-style workplace process cues. Normal calm first-attempt requests are left alone.
